definitions.explanation: The very best quality or option among alternatives. More formal than 一番いい and often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {最良|さいりょう}の{方法|ほうほう}を{選|えら}ぶ。
それが{最良|さいりょう}の{選択|せんたく}だったと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think that was the best choice.

examples.japanese: {患者|かんじゃ}にとって{最良|さいりょう}の{治療法|ちりょうほう}を{提案|ていあん}するのが{医師|いし}の{務|つと}めだ。
examples.english: It is a doctor's duty to recommend the optimal treatment for the patient.

notes: More formal and literary than {一番|いちばん}いい or ベスト. Common collocations: {最良|さいりょう}の{方法|ほうほう} (the best method), {最良|さいりょう}の{選択|せんたく} (the best choice), {最良|さいりょう}の{結果|けっか} (the best result). The opposite is {最悪|さいあく} (the worst). Not to be confused with the homophone {裁量|さいりょう} (discretion).
